name: Civil Engineering
about: Four-year civil engineering degree in English (240 ECTS) with two specialisations, Structural Engineering and Infrastructure Engineering: bridges, buildings, roads, railways and water works.

name: Computer Science Engineering
about: Computer science, algorithms, programming, networks, AI and data security, with two specialisations from semester five: Software Engineering and Infocommunication (210 ECTS).

name: Electrical Engineering
about: Electrical and electronic engineering from power systems to microelectronics, control and programming, with specialisations in embedded and control systems, infocommunication or sustainable energy.

name: Mechanical Engineering
about: Mechanics, materials, fluid and thermal sciences and control, combined with laboratory and design work; a broad base for mechanical engineering practice (210 ECTS).

name: Vehicle Engineering
about: Vehicle structures, systems, materials and maintenance, for the automotive industry's shift to new vehicle technologies (210 ECTS).

name: Engineering Management
about: Engineering plus management: technology, IT, organisation and finance for planning and running technical and economic processes, taught project by project (210 ECTS).

name: Professional Pilot
about: A BSc combined with a commercial pilot licence: flight theory and practical training, ending with multi-crew training in an Airbus A320 simulator environment (210 ECTS).

name: Physics
about: Theoretical and experimental physics with mathematics and programming, with a Research Physicist or an Applied Physics specialisation, leading towards the BME Master's (180 ECTS).

name: Physicist-Engineer
about: Engineering, physics, maths, computing and data science together: quantum and nano technology, photonics, materials, energy and nuclear technology (210 ECTS).

name: Mathematics
about: Pure and applied mathematics and mathematical modelling, with project work and a route to research or finance and IT jobs (180 ECTS).

name: Chemical Engineering
about: Analytical, organic and materials chemistry with chemical engineering, maths, physics and economics; specialisation starts in semester five (210 ECTS).

name: Architectural Engineering (single-cycle)
about: Five-year path straight to a master's in architectural engineering, balancing technical skills (maths and physics) with design; specialise from year four in real estate, sustainable architecture or urban design.

name: Culture, Politics and Society
about: Interdisciplinary degree in English combining political science, sociology, anthropology and cultural studies to examine how societies change; a 3-year Austrian degree, or 4 years for the US and Austrian degrees.

name: Data Science and Society
about: Data science joined with economics, politics and cognitive science in English: computational analysis and modelling applied to social questions, with one of three specialisations; 3 years (Austrian BSc) or 4 years (US BA and Austrian BSc).

name: Philosophy, Politics and Economics
about: PPE degree in English building foundations in philosophy, politics and economics, then one of three specialisation tracks; a 3-year Austrian degree, or 4 years for the US and Austrian degrees.

name: Applied Economics
about: Six-semester economics degree in English on economic concepts, structured model-based thinking and data analysis tools, with mathematics used as a tool; small classes lead on to competitive master's programmes.

name: Business and Management
about: Seven-semester EFMD-accredited business degree in English covering finance, marketing, accounting, data analysis and business law, with specialisations in year 3 and a compulsory 480-hour internship.

name: Business Informatics
about: Seven-semester degree in English linking business and IT: providing IT solutions to business problems as analyst, developer or project team member, with a compulsory 320-hour internship.

name: Communication and Media Science
about: Six-semester social-science degree in English on communication, sociology, politics and philosophy, with media production in studios, five specialisations and an 80-hour internship.

name: Data Science in Business
about: Eight-semester data science degree in English with strong maths, statistics and programming (Python, SQL, R), practical data-lab projects and about 480 hours of internship; no programming experience needed.

name: International Relations
about: Six-semester degree in English on diplomacy, global politics, economics and international law, with negotiation and analysis skills, simulations and an 80-hour internship.

name: International Business
about: Eight-semester cross-cultural business degree in English, project-based with marketing, finance and management, a semester abroad and a compulsory internship.

name: Philosophy, Politics, Economy (PPE)
about: Six-semester interdisciplinary degree in English joining philosophy, politics and economics, with eight specialisations you choose later and training in analysis, policy and decision-making.

name: Psychology
about: Three-year English-language psychology degree: theoretical foundations and basic methods, behavioural measurement and experiments, and applied branches, qualifying you for psychology master's degrees (180 ECTS).

name: English and American Studies
about: English studies or American studies track, chosen after the first term: academic writing, English literature, British and American history and linguistics; does not give teaching qualifications.

name: Computer Science
about: Programming, software engineering and the mathematical and theoretical background of informatics, taught in English at the Faculty of Informatics in Budapest (180 ECTS).

name: Applied Economics
about: General economics training with methodology and social, political and international applications, plus an introduction to other social sciences and business studies (180 ECTS).

name: International Relations
about: International politics, security studies, EU politics, ethnic conflict, global justice and human rights, with electives after a first year of social-science introductions (180 ECTS).

name: Mechanical Engineering
about: Mechanical engineers for machine design and production, using computer-aided engineering and Industry 4.0 technology; taught in English at ELTE's Szombathely campus (210 ECTS).

name: Kindergarten Education
about: Trains kindergarten educators for children aged 3-6: pedagogy theory, practical skills and planning of pre-school activities, taught in person in English in Budapest.

name: International Business Economics
about: Four-year economics and business degree in English at ELTE's Faculty of Economics: management, economic analysis and international trade, with law and social-science electives (240 ECTS).

name: Sociology
about: Sociology with project-based teaching, one semester of intensive project work and specialisations such as data analysis or criminology (180 ECTS).

name: Finance and Accounting
about: Finance and accounting with a general business-economics base, preparing for controller, audit and accountancy careers; taught in English at ELTE's Faculty of Economics (210 ECTS).

name: Early Childhood Education
about: Prepares nursery educators for children aged 0-3: pedagogical competence and the cognitive and emotional development of the first three years, taught in English.

name: Special Needs Education
about: Four-year degree for special needs teachers and therapists who support children and adults with disabilities, in English, at the Bárczi Gusztáv Faculty in Budapest (240 ECTS).

name: Pedagogy
about: Learning and teaching across schools, adult and vocational education and civil society, with psychology, sociology and policy; final two semesters on digital education (180 ECTS).

name: Chemistry
about: Research-oriented chemistry on a base of maths, physics and core chemical disciplines, with extensive lab work and modern instrumentation; a newly launched programme (180 ECTS).

name: Animation
about: Animation film from drawing to motion picture: design of characters and backgrounds, animation techniques, film tricks and games or apps; prior drawing or software experience helps but is not required.

name: Environmental Design
about: Design of spaces and objects with an ecological approach, taught through personal consultation and workshops where you build prototypes in the in-house workshop.

name: Film and Media Studies
about: Film history and theory with hands-on courses in directing, scriptwriting, cinematography, editing, sound and production management, in an international group.

name: Graphic Design
about: Graphic design from illustration to book, identity and poster design, branding and packaging, moving to interactive and responsive work in the third year.

name: Media Design
about: Screen graphics, motion pictures, sound, 3D and game design, UX, visual effects and interactive installations, with the first year on visual logic and composition.

name: Communication and Media Studies
about: Communication theory, mass media, psychology and marketing, then a specialisation in International Communication or Integrated Media from the third semester.

name: International Relations
about: International, intercultural and transnational relations, with professional use of foreign languages, for careers in the international arena.

name: Human Resource Management
about: HR processes and people: recruitment and selection, training, incentives and how technology is changing work (210 ECTS).

name: International Business Economics
about: EU integration and policies, world economic regions, foreign trade, international economics and finance and negotiation techniques (240 ECTS).

name: Business Administration and Management
about: Management and business knowledge with analytical and organisational skills for running business processes (210 ECTS).

name: Commerce and Marketing
about: Business and economics with commerce and marketing: brands, selling and group practical training (210 ECTS).

name: Finance and Accounting
about: Corporate finance, capital markets and financial processes, taught analytically with the latest financial tools and software (210 ECTS).

name: Tourism and Catering
about: Tourism and catering in Budapest, with third-year specialisations in Health Tourism or International Hotel Management (240 ECTS).

name: Business Administration and Management
about: Trains economists to understand, plan and analyse how business organisations run, with specialisations in Digital Manager or Project Management and B2B Marketing; includes a work placement (210 ECTS).

name: Commerce and Marketing
about: Economics and business knowledge with commerce and marketing skills for selling products and services and running commercial activity in small and medium firms (210 ECTS).

name: Computer Science Engineering
about: Programming, software engineering, databases, networks and security, with a specialisation in Cloud Service Technologies and IT Security from semester four (210 ECTS).

name: Electrical Engineering
about: Electrical engineering with natural sciences, economics and humanities, and specialisations in automation, communication technologies, embedded systems or energy (210 ECTS).

name: Engineering Management
about: Engineering managers with natural and technical science, economics and organisation skills for production and service work, with specialisations in project or corporate management (210 ECTS).

name: Environmental Engineering
about: Applied natural sciences, ecology, technology and management for preventing and cleaning up pollution and using resources well; specialisations in energy, green energy and land, or water (210 ECTS).

name: Industrial Design Engineering
about: Engineers who design, make and market industrial products, with product design (interior, textile, fashion accessories) or packaging specialisations; combines technology, aesthetics and economics (210 ECTS).

name: Mechatronical Engineering
about: Mechanical engineering, electronics and computer control together, for designing and running mechatronic devices and smart machines; robotics or intelligent control specialisation (210 ECTS).

name: General Medicine
about: Six-year medical degree in English at the Medical School: basic and pre-clinical modules, a clinical core, then a year of clinical rotations.

name: Dentistry
about: Five-year dental degree in English at the Medical School, joining basic and clinical science from the first years and ending in the DMD title.

name: Pharmacy
about: Five-year one-tier pharmacy degree in English (10 semesters): basic sciences first, then pharmacy teaching and hospital placements, industry and research.

name: Accelerated Pharmacy-Biotechnology Degree Pathway
about: Combined pharmacy and biotechnology path in English over 5+1 years (12 semesters), with laboratory training and projects aimed at drug development and biopharma production.

name: Architecture (BSc + MSc)
credential: Master of Science in Architecture (5 years)
about: Five-year one-tier architecture degree in English covering design, town and country planning, heritage, structures and building management.

name: Graphic Artist Specialising in Graphic Design
credential: Master of Arts, Graphic Artist (5 years)
about: Five-year one-tier art degree in English training graphic artists in drawing-based graphic genres, from study drawing to professional graphic design.

name: Painting
about: Five-year one-tier painting degree in English building from drawing and basic painting techniques towards a personal artistic practice.

name: Sculpture
about: Five-year one-tier sculpture degree in English training sculptors who work with materials, techniques and the expressive means of sculpture.

name: Archaeology
about: Three-year archaeology degree in English on the theory and methods of the field and two chosen specialisations, opening work on excavations and in museums and research.

name: Liberal Arts
about: Three-year multidisciplinary humanities BA in English (majors: art history, classical studies, ethics, film and visual studies) where you build your own programme around majors such as art history, classical studies, film and visual studies, or philosophy.

name: Communication and Media Science
about: Three-year degree in English with a Digital Media and Public Relations specialisation: journalism, PR, advertising and organisational communication, with hands-on media production.

name: English and American Studies
about: Three-year BA in English on the language, literatures and cultures of English-speaking peoples, with inter- and multi-disciplinary approaches.

name: International Relations
about: Interdisciplinary three-year politics and social-science degree in English, with courses on global issues, developing countries, Asia and European and Central Eastern European affairs.

name: Pedagogy (Intercultural Educational Assistant)
about: Three-year pedagogy degree in English with an intercultural educational assistant specialisation, opening work in community education, counselling and educational policy.

name: Pre-school Teaching
about: Three-year degree in English training teachers for children aged 3 to 7, with practice from the first semester and a wide choice of optional modules.

name: Psychology
about: Three-year psychology BA in English linking the biological and social sciences with the humanities, preparing for specialised study or many careers.

name: Romology (Roma Studies)
about: Three-year degree in English training experts in Roma studies, with a Boyash or Romani language-and-culture specialisation, to work with Roma communities and organisations.

name: Social Work
about: Seven-semester social work degree in English on social systems, human behaviour and social justice, with theory and practice modules.

name: Business Administration and Management
about: EFMD-accredited seven-semester business degree in English taught with cases, practical tasks, teamwork and guest lecturers, with optional modules in marketing, management or finance.

name: Architectural Engineering
about: Seven-semester degree in English on engineering design, structures and construction management, built around the architect's responsibility for building design and team work.

name: Civil Engineering
about: Eight-semester degree in English on large structures, building and infrastructure engineering, plus computers, economics and communication skills.

name: Computer Science Engineering
about: Seven-semester engineering-side computing degree in English on software engineering, networks and information systems, with much laboratory work and project experience.

name: Mechanical Engineering
about: Seven-semester practical mechanical engineering degree in English for the built environment and industry, with planning, industrial management and systems engineering modules.

name: Electrical Engineering
about: Seven-semester degree in English in designing, making and operating electrical and electronic equipment, with measurement and control tasks.

name: Biology
about: Three-year biology degree in English with neurobiology, genetics, microbiology, ecology, botany and zoology, and a choice between lab-based and ecology-based modules.

name: Biotechnology
about: Three-year biotechnology degree in English from the Faculty of Pharmacy: basic sciences first, then biochemistry, genetics, molecular biology and lab placements in industry or research.

name: Chemistry
about: Three-year chemistry degree in English with inorganic, organic, analytical, environmental and physical chemistry, instrumental analysis and maths.

name: Computer Science
about: Three-year computer science degree in English on programming, discrete mathematics, calculus, software technology and systems, for coding work or master's study.

name: Earth Sciences
about: Three-year earth sciences degree in English with an optional geology specialisation, covering geomorphology, geophysics, hydrology, meteorology and remote sensing.

name: Geography
about: Three-year geography degree in English with directions in landscape and environment, regional development or tourism, each built on a GIS foundation.

name: Mathematics
about: Three-year mathematics degree in English: logic, algebra, number theory, calculus, geometry, probability and game theory, feeding into applied mathematics and operations research.

name: Physical Training
about: Three-year coaching degree in English with modules in team and individual sports, sport medicine, social aspects and sport sciences; you choose one sport specialisation.

name: Physics
about: Three-year physics degree in English with common maths, physics and informatics courses, then applied physics or informatics in physics.

name: Nursing
about: Four-year nursing degree in English on prevention, treatment, nursing and rehabilitation at each level of health and social care, with hospital and community practice.

name: Midwifery
about: Four-year midwifery degree in English supporting women through pregnancy, childbirth and the postpartum period, practice-oriented with clinical placements.

name: Dietetics
about: Four-year dietetics degree in English on food chemistry, nutrition and diet therapy for preventing and treating disease.

name: Physiotherapy
about: Four-year physiotherapy degree in English on movement and exercise therapy, musculoskeletal anatomy and rehabilitation techniques.

name: Classical Instrumental Music Performance (Flute)
about: Three-year classical music BA in English on flute as your main subject, with music theory, chamber music and orchestral training for ensembles and solo careers.

name: Classical Instrumental Music Performance (Guitar)
about: Three-year classical music BA in English on guitar as your main subject, with music theory, chamber music and orchestral training for ensembles and solo careers.

name: Classical Instrumental Music Performance (Piano)
about: Three-year classical music BA in English on piano as your main subject, with music theory, chamber music and orchestral training for ensembles and solo careers.

name: Classical Instrumental Music Performance (Viola)
about: Three-year classical music BA in English on viola as your main subject, with music theory, chamber music and orchestral training for ensembles and solo careers.

name: Classical Instrumental Music Performance (Violin)
about: Three-year classical music BA in English on violin as your main subject, with music theory, chamber music and orchestral training for ensembles and solo careers.

name: Classical Music Singing
about: Three-year classical singing BA in English with voice as your main subject alongside music theory, folk music and music literature.

name: Orchestral and Choral Conducting
about: Three-year degree in English training conductors for orchestras and choirs, combining conducting with vocal studies and theory.

name: Electronic Music and Media Art
about: Three-year BA in English on electronic music, video art and new media, built on philosophy, contemporary aesthetics, network laws and art history.

name: Designer Making: Ceramics Design
about: Three-year studio-based design BA in English combining design, material research, 3D design and 3D printing, on the Zsolnay Cultural Quarter campus.

name: Designer Making: Fashion and Textiles Design
about: Three-year design BA in English with a fashion and textile design specialisation built around contemporary tapestry art, taught in the Design and Media Art Department.
